description: Source code implementing a WGL (Windows OpenGL) PbufferSurface class for managing pixel buffers in an OpenGL context, including creation, destruction, binding, and querying functions.

classes.name: PbufferSurfaceWGL
classes.description: A class managing an OpenGL pixel buffer surface (pbuffer) on Windows using WGL, handling creation, destruction, and buffer operations.

methods.name: PbufferSurfaceWGL
methods.description: Constructor initializing the pbuffer surface with specified parameters.

methods.name: ~PbufferSurfaceWGL
methods.description: Destructor releasing resources associated with the pbuffer.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the pbuffer, creating it and querying its size.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes the pbuffer current in the OpenGL context.

methods.name: postSubBuffer
methods.description: Posts a sub-region of the buffer.

methods.name: bindTexImage
methods.description: Binds a texture image to the pbuffer.

methods.name: releaseTexImage
methods.description: Releases the texture image from the pbuffer.

methods.name: setSwapInterval
methods.description: Sets the swap interval for buffer swapping.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the pbuffer.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the pbuffer.

methods.name: isPostSubBufferSupported
methods.description: Indicates if post sub-buffer is supported.

methods.name: getSwapBehavior
methods.description: Returns the swap behavior of the buffer.

methods.name: getDC
methods.description: Returns the device context handle for the pbuffer.
